# Dagboog Web Instructions

- Keep the web prototype self-contained in this folder; do not import from the parent Python notebook project.
- Keep solar and date calculations in `src/astro.js` and visualization components in their own `src/` files.
- Preserve the static relative asset base in `vite.config.js` for GitHub Pages subpath hosting.
- Validate changes with `npm run lint` and `npm run build`.
